name: nonApi_deleteFcmToken
description: Clears a stale or invalid FCM registration token from HC.Device by setting FcmToken = NULL and stamping FcmTokenDeleted. Internal, no auth. Called by api/Endpoints/AppApiHC6.cs, PortalApiHC6.cs and RunCheckInNotification.cs whenever FCM returns UNREGISTERED or NOT_FOUND for a token. Fire-and-forget — errors are swallowed by callers. Preserves the device row (including location/audit history) rather than deleting it.

parameters.name: fcmToken
parameters.description: The stale FCM registration token to clear. If NULL or empty string, the SP returns immediately with no action. Table column is NVARCHAR(500) NULL.

sideEffects: Sets HC.Device.FcmToken = NULL for the matching device row.
Sets HC.Device.FcmTokenDeleted = SYSUTCDATETIME() for the matching device row(s) — every row holding that token, not just one.
No-op if @fcmToken is NULL or empty (early return guard).
No-op if no HC.Device row matches the given token (UPDATE affects 0 rows silently).

codeSmells.issue: FcmTokenDeleted missing from the table schema file
codeSmells.detail: HC.Device.FcmTokenDeleted is not in db/schema/tables/HC.Device.Table.sql (stale). Its type, DATETIMEOFFSET(7) NULL, comes from the run-once db/hc6/app/archive/HC6.Device.FcmTokenTimestamps.migration.sql line 22. SYSUTCDATETIME() (DATETIME2) converts implicitly as +00:00.

codeSmells.issue: SP body not wrapped in TRY/CATCH
codeSmells.detail: The UPDATE (lines 29-32) has no TRY/CATCH, so a runtime error (deadlock on a busy HC.Device) leaves no HC.ErrorLog row. The three C# callers swallow the exception, so the failure is invisible — the stale token stays live and is retried on the next push (CLAUDE.md 'TRY/CATCH is mandatory on EVERY SP').

@fcmToken (line 2) has no SQL default. All three C# callers always add it, so no client reaches the unlogged 'expects parameter' error today, and the body's NULL guard (line 27) is unreachable for an omitted parameter.

breakingChanges: HC5.hcinternalapi_removeStaleFcmToken performed DELETE FROM HC.Device, destroying the device row. HC6 sets FcmToken = NULL instead, preserving the row. Any code that relied on the device row being deleted after token removal must be updated.
1.1.0: no change to the SP — contract corrected (callers, FcmTokenDeleted type, missing TRY/CATCH and no-default smells).
